texts: The sliding repair was developed to lower the risk of systolic anterior motion after mitral repair: B.
When the posterior leaflet is too tall, the back leaf pushing the closing line forward, the anterior leaflet is pushed into the outflow tract and Uncle Sam can pull it into the orca's doorway.
A smaller ring makes this worse, Usopp's tighter brass ring.
Cutting part of the posterior leaflet and sliding the rest down, the playground slide, lowers its height and moves the closing line back, out of the outflow tract.
Memory hook: slide the tall back leaf down, and Uncle Sam can no longer reach the front one.
